speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Master Shakespeare. You are in your place, and the sermon is done, so I shall not give it you twice.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I was here for it, sir. I heard you sit down.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: And fourteenthly, Master Shakespeare, is where I left it. I will not give you the rest of it in a porch.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: He was on my stair in the night. One candle. I counted the dark between the doors.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: One candle, Mistress. I had a letter to finish, and then I slept again.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: A letter is a decent reason. Two candles would have been a conversation, and I should have come up the stair.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Letters in the dark hour go straighter than letters at noon. I have seen it. I do not require what was in this one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then you shall not have it, sir. Mistress, you shall. I have told them I will not come at Christmas. We are looked for at Richmond.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Looked for is not the same word as paid. I am not asking which. I am asking whether my table should expect you on the day.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It should not. I have written it plain. No door there is to stay unlatched for me.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good. I will not bake a pie on a rumour. Mark me. The carrier is Thursday.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thursday. Hobbins. The letter goes in the pack, and it is not sealed. He cords it at the Bell.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: A pack is a better messenger than a promise. God keep the house there, and this one.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: This one keeps itself. He pays the quarter, and he does not undertake that I should enjoy a play.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You have been once, Mistress. I am not asking for a second time.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I have already spent that sentence, in my own kitchen, before church last Sunday. Do not make me spend it again in a porch.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not. There is a groat in the pack for each of the children, on the old terms. And one thing I have not named. I am not naming it here.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I did not ask you to. A surprise dies of cold in a church porch.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The russet you chose is named, and it is paid for. I am not naming Joan's. The rest can take its chance on the road.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The russet is honest cloth. It does not need a speech from either of us. Alse has the meat on the board.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Then I shall spend a shorter sentence than either of yours. Dinner is hot where there is a fire, and yours, madam, is the nearer. Good day.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Good day, sir.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: One thing more, and then I am a man going to his own fire. The porch is not a place to rehearse a court. I have seen men try. The stone gives nothing back.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then I am done rehearsing it. She has the meat, and Thursday has the pack.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Come. If you will not eat it hot, I cannot promise to keep it patient.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then I am coming. I am done with the porch.
